system.description: The spell fills the victim's mind with terrifying visions of the creature they fear most. They can resist with a Situation roll of 8, modified by Psyche. Failure immediately inflicts 1d10 Fear Points and their consequences.
system.summary: The spell sends a wave of manipulative energy through a chosen victim, overwhelming its thoughts with horrific visions.

powerLevels.effect: Affect another creature within range, which receives the spell's basic effect
Reduce the victim's chance to succeed on the Situation roll by -1
Increase range by 5 meters (physical contact is no longer necessary)
Increase Fear Points inflicted by one step: 1d10 > 1d10JO10 > 1d10JO9 > 1d10JO8 > 1d10JO8 + 1
